messages:
mike: Sealed installer build ready for private/vpc: sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321. Uploaded to staging. Need cosign + deploy window.

jen: I can cover the window. Which KMS key?

pkg_signer: I'll sign. Confirm KMS alias and exact manifest tag. Also need brief release note line.

mike: KMS: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/installer-sign. Tag: sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321. Notes: on-prem airgap bundle, delta-apply tweak, libtls CVE fixes.

pkg_signer: ACK. Will run cosign and upload signature to s3://redwood-staging/airgap/v2.14.0-rc1/signature.json.

deploy-bot: Canary window requested by <@mike>: 23:00-23:30 UTC. Targets: 3 reserved VPC canaries. Policy: require >=2/3 healthy to proceed; fallback rollback to v2.13.7.

ops_ryan: I'll monitor; threshold: canary errors >3% over 5m -> hold. Also watch disk warnings.

sre_aly: Add preflight checksum failure metric (>1% abort) and KV cache sanity check in canary.

maria-support: Need SHA256 and cosign key id for customer KB.

mike: SHA256 in staging manifest; cosign key id projects/release/keys/installer-signer-v3.

pkg_signer: cosign command: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/release/.../installer-sign gcr.io/redwood/sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321`. Uploading now.

pkg_signer: Signed. SignatureID sig-20260321-01 uploaded.

deploy-bot: Locking manifest to tag for window. Pre-warm 5m before 23:00. Ensure deploybot/hooks/private_transport.yaml prehook enabled.

jen: Preflight on canary-2: checksum OK, prehook exit 0, health probes 200. Minor disk layout warning only.

ops_ryan: Not blocking. Replacing mirror-2 after a truncated download during canary-3, re-run succeeded.

sre_aly: Observability checks look stable; no KV regressions seen so far.

mike: Proceeding with staged rollout: 10% batches every 15m, auto-hold on >2% error. Add rollback steps to release notes: use `--legacy-apply` for delta-apply failures and fallback to v2.13.7 for mass checksum issues.

maria-support: KB published with cosign verification commands and rollback steps. Link: https://internal.docs/redwood/releases/v2.14.0-rc1

deploy-bot: Staged rollout complete. Final: success. Artifacts pinned: sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321.
